shortDescription: Allows administration of Keycloak groups using Keycloak API

options.name: attributes
options.description: A dict of key/value pairs to set as custom attributes for the group. Values may be single values (for example a string) or a list of strings.

options.name: auth_client_id
options.description: OpenID Connect C(client_id) to authenticate to the API with.

options.name: auth_client_secret
options.description: Client Secret to use in conjunction with O(auth_client_id) (if required).

options.name: auth_password
options.description: Password to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: auth_realm
options.description: Keycloak realm name to authenticate to for API access.

options.name: auth_username
options.description: Username to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: connection_timeout
options.description: Controls the HTTP connections timeout period (in seconds) to Keycloak API.

options.name: id
options.description: The unique identifier for this group. This parameter is not required for updating or deleting a group but providing it reduces the number of API calls required.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the group. This parameter is required only when creating or updating the group.

options.name: parents
options.description: List of parent groups for the group to handle sorted top to bottom. Set this to create a group as a subgroup of another group or groups (parents) or when accessing an existing subgroup by name. Not necessary to set when accessing an existing subgroup by its C(ID) because in that case the group can be directly queried without necessarily knowing its parent(s).

options.name: realm
options.description: They Keycloak realm under which this group resides.

options.name: refresh_token
options.description: Authentication refresh token for Keycloak API.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the group. On V(present), the group is created if it does not yet exist, or updated with the parameters you provide. On V(absent), the group is removed if it exists. Be aware that absenting a group with subgroups automatically deletes all its subgroups too.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Verify TLS certificates (do not disable this in production).
